entry.description: Split `flume-rpc-avro` into `flume-avro-client`, `flume-avro-source`, `flume-avro-sink`, `flume-avro-serializer` and `flume-spooldir-source`, so Avro clients only depend on `flume-client`. The Avro protocol keeps its `org.apache.flume.source.avro` package for wire compatibility with Flume 1.x, while `AvroSource` moves to `org.apache.flume.source.avro.server`
